reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 261 seats, the figure Ilse posted in that channel on Oct 14.

Moss's March 23 digest says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20 by Ilse (acting) and Thea Ramaswell, but it doesn't give a seat count. I couldn't find the signed contract in the shared files, so the 261 isn't checked against it. I suggested Dana confirm with Ilse or June if she needs that for the tracker. I also told her the 185 from August 2025 was the old Amendment No. 1 count, not the renewal figure.
